testcase.name: reads exclude sub-second points, count them, and leave the stored rows untouched
batched insert of 1000 points is meaningfully cheaper than the same points one at a time
getFullRecord on a track with no stored points, or no such track, is an empty list not a failure
a track's origin waypoint pointer round-trips, and a track without one reads back null
a point's speed and speed accuracy round-trip, and a point without them reads back null in both
a created track starts with no points and no end time
a getById miss returns a successful null, not a failure
getFullRecord returns every stored point with its verdict, unlike getById's filtered read
ending a track sets its end time and leaves everything else untouched
setting the origin pointer updates the stored track, and a missing track is not a failure
deleting a track removes its points too
appended points come back in timestamp order regardless of insertion order
